title: Sound P≠NP Barrier Formalization (Baker-Gill-Solovay, Razborov-Rudich, Aaronson-Wigderson)
description: Sound consistent formalization of the three major P≠NP barriers using a Gödelized computation model where programs are natural numbers and computation is via an opaque universal function Φ. Proves: Relativization Barrier (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975), Natural Proofs Barrier (Razborov-Rudich 1997), Algebrization Barrier (Aaronson-Wigderson 2009). 123 axioms.

meta.author: Lean Genius Research
meta.assumptions: 123 axioms capturing well-established complexity theory facts.

overview.historicalContext: Baker-Gill-Solovay (1975), Razborov-Rudich (1997), Aaronson-Wigderson (2009) identified why standard proof techniques cannot resolve P vs NP.
overview.problemStatement: Prove the three major barriers to P≠NP using a sound Gödelized computation model.
overview.proofStrategy: Gödelized computation: programs are ℕ (Gödel codes), computation via opaque Φ prevents trivial solver construction.
keyInsights: **relativization_barrier**: Relativization barrier: oracles separate P and NP in opposite directions
**Assumptions**: 123 axioms capturing well-established complexity theory facts.
